name: Clash Action SDK
purpose: Define and assemble executable Plugin contributions against the shared invocation, Host-context, and result ABI.
runtimeBoundary: PluginModule is transport-neutral and browser-safe through the ./browser entrypoint. The runner chooses local, cloud, or client; servePluginStdio adapts the same module to process/stdio. Realm and transport never enter Plugin invocation or Generator semantic identity. Provider error contracts use ./executable-failure, a pure implementation shared with the Node root export; portable consumers must not import the root assemble/stdio entrypoint.
invariants: Manifest declarations and implementation contributions must match exactly before invocation.
Every invocation receives Host-scoped capabilities; Plugin code never chooses another Plugin or account scope.
Local, cloud, client, and stdio execution share one module dispatch and result-normalization path.
Generator Actions use kind=action in both realms: defineAction is submit-only compatibility sugar, while defineActionExecutor exposes durable submit/poll/callback through the same ABI.
Importing or invoking a PluginModule does not start or access a transport.
